frontend/src/ui/index.tsx:157-165 Res component emits an <Image> with testID `${testID}-art` when art={true} and the resource art asset resolves — battle-tab ResultCard passes art on the gold Res (testID result-gold-art wired).

frontend/src/ui/ItemIcon.tsx:18 emits `${testID}-art` on the illustrated item image ONLY when parent passes testID — battle.tsx passes testID for loot tiles (loot-<id>) and hero/gear detail passes testID='item-detail-icon'. QAT now has: (a) a resolved war row (attacker wins 10-0) that is visible in the Guerre list, (b) attack_limit_per_alliance_hours cooldown active for 24h from now, (c) node 21 owned as QAT territory (bumping QAT season points to 100 — leaderboard now ties 100/100 with ORS), (d) an active Titan Hunt tier-1 run at 0.9% HP dealt. context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest for wars now lives at /app/backend/tests/test_alliance_wars.py — run with `cd /app/backend && PYTHONPATH=/app/backend pytest tests/test_alliance_wars.py -v`. The conftest imports server so pytest MUST be run from /app/backend (or with PYTHONPATH). The E2E in this test file WILL declare on node 21 if no active war exists for QAT, so it consumes the 24h attack cooldown; if QAT already has an active war it reuses it. The 2 'skipped' tests (roster >10 -> 400 and non-officer -> 403) require a 'prep'-status war to exist; consider seeding one from ORS onto a QAT neutral node in seed_war_demo.py. ResourceBar regression is intact — the top bar has ZERO .
